headline: Wood pyrolysis power deal, Burlington City Arts lease at 405 Pine Street, and $40,000 in Community Celebrations grants.
summary: Burlington Electric items include position changes, proposed tariff changes, and a 20-year wood pyrolysis power purchase agreement at McNeil Generating Station. Other items cover a City budget update for July 1 to October 31, 2026, and a UVM PREVENT services agreement with the Fire Department.
items: Community Celebrations grants totaling up to $40,000 over two grant cycles
Acceptance of UVM PREVENT Services Agreement for the Burlington Fire Department
Burlington Electric position updates, effective December 21, 2026 and April 1, 2027
Wood pyrolysis demonstration project 20-year power purchase agreement at McNeil Generating Station
Proposed Burlington Electric tariff changes and pilot program
Renewal and expansion of Burlington City Arts lease at 405 Pine Street
City budget update, July 1 to October 31, 2026
location: Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor
